---
applyTo: "**/*.cs,**/*.csproj,**/*.props,**/*.targets,**/global.json,**/NuGet.Config,**/nuget.config,**/*.sln,**/*.slnx"
---

Read and follow [the canonical C#/.NET standard](../../docs/standards/csharp-dotnet.md). Honor closer project exceptions. Use four spaces, Allman braces, braces for control flow and one statement per line. Preserve contracts and resource/cancellation lifetimes; prefer focused helpers and existing patterns. Run configured formatter, analyzers, tests and builds; do not add dependencies for style.
